summary: Test plugins verify data in Jinja2, can be grouped per file, work with select/map and when, don't use the config system (but can document since 2.14), and should propagate undefined-variable errors.
questions: What are Jinja2 test plugins used for?
Can test plugins be used in when conditions?
How should test plugins handle undefined variables?

answer_card.title: Test plugins
answer_card.answer_md: Test plugins verify data in Jinja2; several per file is fine (core ones in `core.py`). Useful with `select`/`map` and in `when:`. They don't use the config system but can be documented since 2.14. Re-raise `UndefinedError` as `AnsibleUndefinedVariable` and others as `AnsibleFilterError`.
